name: writing-loop
description: An autonomous short-drama (竖屏短剧) writers' room in a folder. Ten agents screen adaptation sources, plan, design, write, review, score, and market-watch scripts through ticket state on a local board. A North Star creative charter plus canonical structured story documents keep season design and continuity coherent without duplicate Markdown mirrors. Supports autonomous novel-adaptation intake and original creation. Operator skill: add-script.
